title: Home guide: tea bag diffusion
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Muscles and bones (7C); the particle model (7G)
source: Written for science/y7 lesson 29 (Home practical guide and safety card: tea bag diffusion (portal worksheet))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

safety: An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Fill the glass with cold water and let it go still.
Lower the tea bag in gently. Do not stir.
Draw what you see at 0, 2 and 5 minutes.
Explain using particles: they move from where there are many to where there are few.
